metadata.question: Does the nighttime light intensity in Aleppo, Syria decrease in 2016 compared to 2012?

data.raw_code: The question is about nighttime light intensity in Aleppo, Syria, comparing 2016 to 2012. I need to: 1. Search strategy: - Use DMSP-OLS or VIIRS for nighttime lights - DMSP-OLS has data up to 2013, VIIRS starts from 2012 - For 2012 and 2016 comparison, VIIRS is better as it covers both years - Use VIIRS DNB Monthly Composites (VNP46A4 or VNP46A2) - Location: Aleppo, Syria - I'll create a point geometry 2. Masking strategy: - Nighttime lights data doesn't need cloud masking - But I should mask out fill values or poor quality pixels - VIIRS has a QF_Cloud_Mask band for quality filtering 3. Logic: - Get mean radiance values for 2012 and 2016 - Compare if 2016 < 2012 - Check for valid data (C1, C2, C3 cases) Let me structure the code: 1. Define geometry for Aleppo 2. Get VIIRS monthly composites for 2012 and 2016 3. Check if collections have data (C1) 4. Calculate mean radiance for each year 5. Check if valid pixels exist (C2) 6. Validate results (C3) 7. Compare and output answer ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions aleppo = ee.Geometry.Point(37.1612, 36.2021) # Aleppo, Syria # Define time periods start_2012 = '2012-01-01' end_2012 = '2012-12-31' start_2016 = '2016-01-01' end_2016 = '2016-12-31' # 2. Data Acquisition - VIIRS Nighttime Lights Monthly Composites # Use VNP46A4: VIIRS/NPP Lunar BRDF-Adjusted Nighttime Lights Yearly Composite # Actually, for yearly comparison, VNP46A4 is yearly composite which is perfect col_2012 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG') \ .filterDate(start_2012, end_2012) \ .filterBounds(aleppo) col_2016 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG') \ .filterDate(start_2016, end_2016) \ .filterBounds(aleppo) # Check if collections have data if col_2012.size().getInfo() == 0: print("2012 Images: 0") print("C1") elif col_2016.size().getInfo() == 0: print("2016 Images: 0") print("C1") else: # Get mean composites for each year img_2012 = col_2012.select('avg_rad').mean() img_2016 = col_2016.select('avg_rad').mean() # Check valid pixels count_2012 = img_2012.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=aleppo, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('avg_rad').getInfo() count_2016 = img_2016.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=aleppo, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('avg_rad').getInfo() if count_2012 == 0 or count_2016 == 0: print(f"2012 Pixels: {count_2012}, 2016 Pixels: {count_2016}") print("C2") else: # Calculate mean radiance values mean_2012 = img_2012.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=aleppo, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('avg_rad').getInfo() mean_2016 = img_2016.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=aleppo, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('avg_rad').getInfo() # Validate results if mean_2012 is None or mean_2016 is None: print(f"2012 Mean: {mean_2012}, 2016 Mean: {mean_2016}") print("C3") else: # Print concise stats print(f"2012: {mean_2012:.2f} nW/cm²/sr ({count_2012} px)") print(f"2016: {mean_2016:.2f} nW/cm²/sr ({count_2016} px)") print(f"Change: {((mean_2016 - mean_2012)/mean_2012*100):.1f}%") # Determine answer if mean_2016 < mean_2012: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
aleppo = ee.Geometry.Point(37.1612, 36.2021)  # Aleppo, Syria

# Define time periods
start_2012 = '2012-01-01'
end_2012 = '2012-12-31'
start_2016 = '2016-01-01'
end_2016 = '2016-12-31'

# 2. Data Acquisition - VIIRS Nighttime Lights Monthly Composites
# Use VNP46A4: VIIRS/NPP Lunar BRDF-Adjusted Nighttime Lights Yearly Composite
# Actually, for yearly comparison, VNP46A4 is yearly composite which is perfect
col_2012 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG') \
    .filterDate(start_2012, end_2012) \
    .filterBounds(aleppo)

col_2016 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG') \
    .filterDate(start_2016, end_2016) \
    .filterBounds(aleppo)

# Check if collections have data
if col_2012.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("2012 Images: 0")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif col_2016.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("2016 Images: 0")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # Get mean composites for each year
    img_2012 = col_2012.select('avg_rad').mean()
    img_2016 = col_2016.select('avg_rad').mean()
    
    # Check valid pixels
    count_2012 = img_2012.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=aleppo,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('avg_rad').getInfo()
    
    count_2016 = img_2016.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=aleppo,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('avg_rad').getInfo()
    
    if count_2012 == 0 or count_2016 == 0:
        print(f"2012 Pixels: {count_2012}, 2016 Pixels: {count_2016}")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        # Calculate mean radiance values
        mean_2012 = img_2012.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=aleppo,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('avg_rad').getInfo()
        
        mean_2016 = img_2016.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=aleppo,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('avg_rad').getInfo()
        
        # Validate results
        if mean_2012 is None or mean_2016 is None:
            print(f"2012 Mean: {mean_2012}, 2016 Mean: {mean_2016}")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        else:
            # Print concise stats
            print(f"2012: {mean_2012:.2f} nW/cm²/sr ({count_2012} px)")
            print(f"2016: {mean_2016:.2f} nW/cm²/sr ({count_2016} px)")
            print(f"Change: {((mean_2016 - mean_2012)/mean_2012*100):.1f}%")
            
            # Determine answer
            if mean_2016 < mean_2012:
                print("<answer>A</answer>")
            else:
                print("<answer>B</answer>")
